rule.message:
All students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements.
Collegiate Requirements:
All CLA BA degrees require 18 upper-division (3xxx-level or higher) credits outside the major designator. These credits must be taken in designators different from the major designator and cannot include courses that are cross-listed with the major designator. The major designator for the Asian and Middle Eastern Studies BA is AMES.
Students are required to complete 4 semester(s) of any second language, with a grade of C-, or better, or S, or demonstrate proficiency in the language(s) as defined by the department or college.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) must complete the First-Year Experience course sequence.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) students earning a BA, BS, or BIS degree must complete CLA 3002 or another approved career or internship course (CLA 3101, CLA 3201, CLA 3301, CLA 3896, or CLA 3996).
All students must complete a capstone in at least one CLA major. The requirements for double majors completing the capstone in a different CLA major will be clearly stated. Students must also complete all major requirements in both majors to allow the additional capstone to be waived. Students completing an additional degree must complete the Capstone in each degree area.
Students are required to complete 4 semester(s) of Arabic, or Chinese, or Hindi, or Hmong, or Japanese, or Korean, or Urdu. with a grade of C-, or better, or S, or demonstrate proficiency in the language(s) as defined by the department or college.
At least 17 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
Students with advanced or native language ability may substitute AMES 3xxx-5xxx literature/culture courses in lieu of the major language requirement; see departmental advisor for final consent.
Students may earn a BA or a minor in Asian and Middle Eastern Studies, but not both. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

No courses are required to declare the major but students should have started a language course in Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Hmong, Japanese, Korean, or Urdu. Placement testing is required for students who wish to begin with the second semester or higher language courses and have no previous University courses. Study abroad or transfer courses may be approved by the Directors of Language Instruction. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Chinese Studies, Japanese Studies, Korean Studies, Middle Eastern Studies, South Asian Studies, Southeast Asian Studies. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
